scope_notes: Named libtest success certifies the asserted native invariant contract only; finite business success is independently checked by run_from_zero_native.py.
This fixture is a same-process, 4-second business window with a 90-second Host process bound; it is distinct from the separate-process 30-second Raw History campaign.
Replay CPU includes network/client replay/confirmation on that thread; nested measurements must not be added to process CPU.
Between-response intervals are wall-clock accounting gaps, including native import plus ordinary calling-thread work; they are not isolated graph CPU.
No safety, cadence, quota or deadline was changed during this readback.
